mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM cms_page p LEFT JOIN cms_page parent ON parent.site_id = p.site_id AND parent.id = p.parent_id WHERE p.site_id = #{siteId} ORDER BY COALESCE(p.sort_order, 0) ASC, p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT
FROM cms_page p LEFT JOIN cms_page parent ON parent.site_id = p.site_id AND parent.id = p.parent_id WHERE p.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at <= #{now} ORDER BY p.published_at ASC, p.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms_page ( site_id, title, slug, summary, content, thumbnail_url, parent_id, sort_order, author, status, main_page, published_at ) VALUES ( #{siteId}, #{page.title}, #{page.slug}, #{page.summary}, #{page.content}, #{page.thumbnailUrl}, #{page.parentId}, #{page.sortOrder}, #{page.author}, #{page.status}, #{page.mainPage}, #{page.publishedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_page SET title = #{page.title}, slug = #{page.slug}, summary = #{page.summary}, content = #{page.content}, thumbnail_url = #{page.thumbnailUrl}, parent_id = #{page.parentId}, sort_order = #{page.sortOrder}, author = #{page.author}, status = #{page.status}, main_page = #{page.mainPage}, published_at = #{page.publishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND id = #{page.id}
UPDATE cms_page SET status = 'PUBLISHED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SCHEDULED'
